title: feat(console): Change Owner on the record page, the list selection bar and the edit form (#35403)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP3RHGWUG7UH3fNa4tBa9UC)_
Fixes #35403

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new published `@object-ui` surface, measured on the export lists (merge base `b3bcfefcb` against head): `onBulkChangeOwner` and `bulkChangeOwnerOffered` props on `ObjectGrid` / `ListView`; `CHANGE_OWNER_BULK_ACTION` (plugin-grid); `FormOwnerLine`, `FormOwnerLineProps`, `FormOwnerLineContext`, `FormOwnerActionTarget`, `FormOwnerLineHost` (plugin-form; the last three also from `/core`); `'transfer'` in `RecordOperation` (plugin-detail); `grid.changeOwner` and `console.changeOwner.*` keys in every locale (i18n); nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat reading 2026-11-22 08:01Z: Q1 A, Q2 A

## 维护者速读

- 控制台用户在记录页、列表批量选择栏和编辑表单上能看到「更改负责人」操作;编辑表单里负责人以只读显示,操作就在旁边。
- 这是「更改负责人」三张卡里的最后一张(控制台界面);服务端接口和规则判断已经在前两张卡里合并。
- 出错时最坏的情况是该显示的按钮没显示,或者在服务端本会拒绝的地方多显示了一个按钮;不改服务端,也不改任何数据规则,撤回这次合并即可。
- 无。

## What changes

**The record page.** The header gets a **Change Owner** entry in its `⋯` menu (`sys_change_owner`, in `RecordDetailView`'s built-in header entries). It is drawn only when all three facts hold, as ruled:

1. The object is structurally eligible.
2. Its switch `userActions.transfer` is on. Facts 1 and 2 come from the spec's one resolution, `resolveUserActionTransfer` in `@objectstack/spec/data`.
3. The explain engine's `transfer` verdict for this record is a definite allow.

The verdict comes from the record page's existing single read. Its `explain` list now asks `transfer` wherever facts 1 and 2 hold. `seedRecordPageReaders` seeds that answer into the same verdict cache `useRecordVerdict` reads, so there is no second per-record request. The queue Claim shares the same answer. If `disabledWhen` holds for the record, the entry is drawn disabled with the reason beside it, as the CRUD entries are.

**One dialog** (`ChangeOwnerDialog`), used by the record action, the form action and the bulk action:

- The picker is labelled with the object's own label for `owner_id`. The served label is passed through `fieldLabel`, and "Owner" (i18n) is used only when the object serves none.
- You can pick a person, or a queue where the object carries the ADR-0142 `queue` column. Queues are read from `sys_queue` only once the queue target is chosen.
- An optional notify checkbox sends `notify: true` only when ticked.
- One record calls `data.changeOwner`; two or more call `data.changeOwnerMany`, both from `@objectstack/client`. There is no server, spec, SDK or REST change.
- A refusal shows the server's own sentence.
- A bulk answer ends in a report: moved, already had this owner, did not move. Every row that did not move is listed with the server's sentence, unsampled.

**The list.** `ObjectGrid`'s selection bar (and its row context menu's bulk section) offers **Change Owner** where the host wires the new optional `onBulkChangeOwner` prop, unless the new optional `bulkChangeOwnerOffered` is `false`; `ListView` forwards both. Wiring `onBulkChangeOwner` makes the rows selectable, as a bulk action does. The Console wires it wherever facts 1 and 2 hold (read client-side, no request), so a user with no bulk Delete, on a view with no authored bulk actions, still gets checkboxes. It passes `bulkChangeOwnerOffered` as the explain engine's `transfer` verdict for the OBJECT, which must be a definite allow (`POST /security/explain` with no `recordId`, one question per object and principal, shared by every list). **The question is asked once a selection is open in the page's list, not when the list opens** (`useListChangeOwnerOffered(objectDef, listSelecting)`, reading the page's existing `useListPageSelecting`). Opening a list therefore costs the server no explain read, the posture the grid's row verdicts already take (`useRecordCrudVerdicts`). Rows that the switch's `visibleWhen` excludes are left out of the request with the same fail-closed fold the bulk Delete runs, and the dialog says how many it left out. The server judges every remaining row again.

**The default edit form.** `owner_id` is still dropped from the form's fields by `filterSystemFields` / `SERVER_OWNED_FIELD_NAMES` and never written by the form. It is now shown read-only on its own line above the fields, with the host's action beside it. The line appears only under a host that mounts `FormOwnerLineContext` (exported from `@object-ui/plugin-form` and its `/core` entry). The Console mounts it around its global edit dialog and the page-mode form. An embedded form without the context is unchanged.

**Strings.** All new strings are in all 11 console locales: `grid.changeOwner` and the `console.changeOwner.*` block. The two counted strings are plural families with a base key in every pack.

## Tests

**Rework round (L1 REWORK 7077241523, L2 FAIL 7077265450), head `7a1cdd56`:**

- **M1.** The changeset's `Clause-②:` line reads `yes (widening)`; its body lists the new surface per package. Measured with the TypeScript checker (`getExportsOfModule` and the members of each exported interface and type) on each entry, merge base `b3bcfefcb` against head. Added names: plugin-grid `CHANGE_OWNER_BULK_ACTION`; plugin-form `FormOwnerActionTarget`, `FormOwnerLine`, `FormOwnerLineContext`, `FormOwnerLineHost`, `FormOwnerLineProps` (root) and `FormOwnerActionTarget`, `FormOwnerLineContext`, `FormOwnerLineHost` (`/core`); plugin-list, plugin-detail (root and `/core`) and i18n add no name. Added members: `ObjectGridComponentProps` / `ObjectGridProps` `onBulkChangeOwner`, `bulkChangeOwnerOffered`; `ListViewProps` `onBulkChangeOwner`, `bulkChangeOwnerOffered`; `RecordOperation` `"delete"|"update"` to `"delete"|"transfer"|"update"`. Removed: none. Re-read on the BUILT declarations of head `7a1cdd56` (the five packages' `dist/*.d.ts`, built under `os-verify-lock`): the same added names on every entry, and the same added members (`ObjectGridComponentProps` / `ObjectGridProps` / `ListViewProps` `onBulkChangeOwner` and `bulkChangeOwnerOffered`, `RecordOperation` with `'transfer'`, the `FormOwner*` members). The built and source lists differ only in declarations this diff does not touch (`ColumnSummarySetting`, `ActivityFilterType`, `RecordStageMenuProps`, a symbol id). The i18n surface is the locale packs' new keys: `grid.changeOwner` and the `console.changeOwner.*` block, in all 11.
- **S1.** `ObjectGrid` turns multi-select on where `onBulkChangeOwner` is wired, and draws the entry only while `bulkChangeOwnerOffered !== false`; the Console wires the prop from facts 1 and 2 and passes the verdict asked once a selection is open. New pin `ObjectView.bulkChangeOwnerReach-35403.test.tsx`, through the real `ObjectView` and grid, for a user who may edit but not delete (`can(…, 'delete')` false) on an object with no authored bulk actions: checkboxes on open and no object-level `transfer` request; ticking both rows asks once and the bar carries `sys_change_owner` and no `delete`. A refused verdict leaves the rows selectable and the bar without Change Owner. Control: an `ownership: 'none'` object draws no checkboxes and asks nothing. 3/3.
- Ablations on committed `7a1cdd56`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restore proved by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. Dropping `|| onBulkChangeOwner` from the multi-select arm (blob `ba88537d73a0` to `1d7490f81be0`) gave 2 failed, 1 passed: the transfer case and the refused case found no checkboxes, and the control stayed green. Dropping `&& bulkChangeOwnerOffered !== false` (to `9d540e94f35b`) gave 1 failed, 2 passed: the refused case drew Change Owner.
- **N3.** The `onBulkChangeOwner` doc now says when the entry is drawn: at any count, except on a list page, where one selected record shows that record's own actions and the bulk entries start at two. That is what the bar does (`singleRowMenu` for one row on a list page); the code is unchanged.
- Re-runs on `7a1cdd56`, under `os-verify-lock`: every app-shell suite naming `ObjectView` or `AppContent`, plus `changeOwner-35403`, `bulkChangeOwner-35403` and the payload pin: Test Files 289 passed (289), Tests 2639 passed (2639).

**Earlier round, head `5d4ddea3`:**

Final head `5d4ddea3`.

- **The six suites the object-level read had turned red, cause read.** `ObjectView.sharedViewSave-35955`, `ObjectView.objectBoundActions-7234`, `ObjectView.footerCalculationDraft-36194`, `ObjectView.readOnlyPackageViewSaves-35974`, `ObjectView.viewRefusal-12112` and `AppContent.draftSaveKeepsList-35932` failed with the network-escape guard's `Network escape: this test reached a REAL socket at http://localhost:3000/api/v1/security/explain`. Every list open asked the explain engine. That was a product cost, not a missing double: the list now asks only once a selection is open, and these suites pass unchanged.
- `RecordDetailView.recordPagePayload-27627`: the pin on the page request's `explain` list now reads `['update', 'delete', 'transfer']`; the fixture object carries an owner, so the transfer verdict rides the same single read. The pin's intent (one request opens a record page) is unchanged.
- `ObjectView.phoneFabSelecting-35883` opens a selection, so it now gets an explain double answering no; any other request throws.
- Runs, all under `os-verify-lock`:
  - every `ObjectView.*` suite plus AppContent, the payload pin and the card file, on `0e97ce47`: Test Files 105 passed, 1 failed (the phone selection suite, fixed in `df44c1a3`);
  - every other app-shell suite naming `ObjectView` or `AppContent`, plus the phone selection suite, on `df44c1a3`: Test Files 188 passed (188), Tests 1720 passed (1720);
  - the whole `@object-ui/i18n` suite (with `count-families-11445`, `de-quote-pairing-3876`, `untranslated-identity-4376`, `zh-hant-generated`, `all-locales-key-parity`), the plugin-form `affordanceGrantMap-12082` census, `bulkChangeOwner-35403` and `changeOwner-35403`, on `5d4ddea3`: Test Files 109 passed (109), Tests 2065 passed, 13 skipped. The first run of this set on `a37c0ac5` was red in `all-locales-key-parity` (the two counted families had no base key in any of the 11 packs); `5d4ddea3` adds them.
- Card pins, all in `changeOwner-35403.test.tsx` and `bulkChangeOwner-35403.test.tsx`: no action on `ownership: 'none'`, `managedBy` and `sys_*` objects even for a platform admin; a `controlled_by_parent` detail shows none by default and shows it with `userActions.transfer: true`; a switched-off `private` object shows none for a `modifyAllRecords` holder; edit without transfer sees `owner_id` read-only and no action; the bulk report renders per-row failures. The five list-gate cases (allow asked once at object grain, refusal, refused read, no open selection asks nothing, ineligible object asks nothing) pass.
- Ablation on committed `5d4ddea3`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `const asks = enabled && !!name && wanted;` changed to drop `&& wanted`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `293da7c28c7d` to `8cae616fd61b`; `changeOwner-35403.test.tsx` went 1 failed, 29 passed (the no-open-selection case); restore proved by blob `293da7c28c7d` == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The earlier visibility-leg ablations are on the previous dev's heads (structural 3 red, switch 2 red, verdict 3 red).
- Type-check on `5d4ddea3`: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` `type-check` (after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure): VERDICT command-exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- L2 S2 and N2 carried by #36395.
- **Seat reading 2026-11-22 08:01Z: Q1 A, Q2 A.** The list reads the explain engine's object-level `transfer` verdict, as the ruling words it. The #30205 row cap stays server-only: over 500 rows the dialog shows the server's own `VALIDATION_ERROR` sentence.
- **N1 (the echo): a row whose owner already was the person picked reads "already had this owner", not "moved".** On one record the dialog leaves the current owner out of the picker and refuses it with the reason shown. In a bulk report the unchanged count is capped at what the server counted updated. A queue target has no person to compare, so every admitted row reads as moved.
- **Change Owner is drawn on a definite allow only**, on the record page, the form and the list. A deployment whose explain engine answers nothing shows no Change Owner anywhere, as the queue Claim beside it does.
- **On the list, Change Owner appears a moment after the selection bar the first time a selection opens for an object** (one round trip); later selections read the kept answer at once.
- **Rows of an object that offers Change Owner are selectable for every user**, the price of asking the verdict only on a selection. A user the verdict refuses, with no other bulk action, gets a selection bar with nothing but its count and its clear button.
- On a list page, one ticked record shows that record's own actions, so the bulk Change Owner starts at two ticked records; that record's page offers Change Owner itself.
- Not wired here (carrier: none; noted, not filed): the non-grid `ListView` bulk surfaces. `onBulkChangeOwner` reaches the grid only.
- A dirty edit form saved after a Change Owner may meet the record's version check (the form re-reads in place only while pristine). Unchanged here.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: `changeOwnerDrawn` and the multi-select arm `hasBulkActions || onBulkChangeOwner`.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/changeOwner.ts`, `useListChangeOwnerOffered` (the `wanted` hold) and `useRecordChangeOwnerOffer` (the three-fact gate, `verdict === true`).
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordPagePayload.ts`: `transfer` now seeds the record verdict as well as the Claim reader.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.bulkChangeOwnerReach-35403.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/changeOwner-35403.test.tsx`. Expected: 33 passed.
